pledges.text: I will tell a grown-up I trust if a friend is in trouble.
I will help a friend who isn't going to school.
I will remember that when someone hurts a child, it is never the child's fault.
I will tell a grown-up I trust if I hear that a child's wedding is being planned.
I will remember that 1098 is free and open at any time.
I will be kind to everyone, at school and at home.

mission.goal: Together, collect 20 stars by helping people around the town.

places.name: A teacher or your head teacher
places.what: At school. They can help with school, and with worries about home or friends.

places.name: The anganwadi centre
places.what: In many villages and towns. The anganwadi worker helps young children and their families, and knows who else can help.

places.name: The Gram Panchayat office
places.what: In a village. The sarpanch and the panchayat help solve problems in the village, and can help stop a child marriage.

places.name: A hospital or health centre
places.what: If someone is hurt or ill. Doctors and nurses help children too.

places.name: A police station
places.what: If someone is in danger or a crime is happening. In an emergency, call 112.

places.name: Child Helpline 1098
places.what: Free, at any time. The people there help children who need care or protection.

review.note: Written by Claude, 2026-10-18. Not shown in the app. The places are general descriptions; check that each is fair for children across India, and that the numbers match the Help Centre (SETUP.md §5). Then set status to "verified" with your name and the date.
checks: places: each description is accurate and fair for children across India (teacher, anganwadi, Gram Panchayat, hospital or health centre, police station, Child Helpline).
places (panchayat): a Gram Panchayat can help stop a child marriage (section 16(2) of the Prohibition of Child Marriage Act, 2006; see the Panchayat card).
places (police, childline) and pledges (helpline): 112 and 1098 are the right numbers, and 1098 is free and open at any time (same check as the Help Centre, SETUP.md §5).
